race.comment: IRAMA (1) is a lightly raced galloper making debut for a new local yard. Presents fitter for a trial and will appreciate this grade fresh. Looks to have found a suitable race on resumption and he can make a statement. THE LITTLE PUMPER (3) also resumes from a break and is fitter for two trials. Should be near peak fitness on the back of those and it wouldn't surprise to see him return in good order. ULUWATU (9) is a well-travelled mare back from north Queensland when safely held at Rockhampton. Fitter for two trials and looks hard to hold out this grade fresh. RARE MOON (11) is fitter for one run from a spell and maps for a perfect trail behind the lead.
